title: Proxmox Cluster Live Telemetry Dashboard
tagline: Micro-dashboard streaming CPU, memory, and container health from private homelab nodes.
description: A minimalist, dark-mode terminal-inspired telemetry interface connected via secure Tailscale tunnels to personal Proxmox hypervisor nodes. Displays real-time IOPS, thermals, and container states with zero external analytics tracking.
interactiveDetails: Live websocket data ticker, CPU temperature gauge, and interactive container reboot simulator.
highlightMetricOrFeature: Zero-latency local SSE stream across private WireGuard mesh
